Can you recommend books written by Jeremy Frommer and Rick Schwartz that belong to the Art category?

mixtral:8x7b.title: The Selling of Vince Ferragamo: The Rise, Fall, and Redemption of an NFL Prodigy
mixtral:8x7b.explanation: A captivating exploration of the sports industry by authors Jeremy Frommer and Rick Schwartz.

mixtral:8x7b.title: Omni Magazine February 1980
mixtral:8x7b.explanation: A fascinating exploration of art and culture, Omni Magazine's February 1980 issue features contributions from Jeremy Frommer and Rick Schwartz, delving into the intersection of creativity and technology during a pivotal era. This edition captures the innovative spirit of the time, making it a must-read for art enthusiasts.

mixtral:8x7b.title: The Art of War by Sun Tzu, translated by John Minford with an introduction by Jeremy Frommer and Rick Schwartz
mixtral:8x7b.explanation: Discover the timeless wisdom of Sun Tzu's The Art of War, introduced by authors Jeremy Frommer and Rick Schwartz.

gemma2:9b.title: The Art of Persuasion
gemma2:9b.explanation: Guide to effective communication and influence techniques.

gemma2:9b.title: Drawing on the Right Side of the Brain
gemma2:9b.explanation: Classic art instruction book focusing on creative visualization.

gemma2:9b.title: Unlocking Creativity: A Guide to Finding Inspiration
gemma2:9b.explanation: Explores methods for boosting artistic expression and innovation.

turns.user_response: I'll go with Omni Magazine February 1980 and The Art of War by Sun Tzu, translated by John Minford with an introduction by Jeremy Frommer and Rick Schwartz.
